newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Farm ministry sees lower 97 soft wheat crop.
newsitem.headline: French Farm ministry sees lower 97 soft wheat crop.

text.p: France's farm ministry predicted on Friday that the 1997 soft wheat crop could decline by 4.3 percent to 33.206 million tonnes from 34.692 million tonnes last year.
In its first crop estimate for the 1997 harvest, the ministry also said barley output could rise 2.3 percent to 9.683 million tonnes from 9.463 million last year.
It also forecast the durum wheat crop might fall 22.4 percent to 974,000 tonnes from 1.254 million in 1996.
The rapeseed crop was put at 2.847 million tonnes, down 2.3 percent from 2.913 million in 1996.
